_doc: Stage-gate config for ENH-132 ProductLifecycleEngine. Bank-overridable thresholds + approval matrix. Defaults reflect Tier-2 Kenya bank baseline; banks tune per their governance maturity.
_notes: Pre-launch transitions (IDEATION/BUSINESS_CASE/DEVELOPMENT) are governed entirely by the approval matrix; no quantitative criteria.
LAUNCH->GROWTH / GROWTH->MATURITY / MATURITY->DECLINE auto-transition when criteria met (no approval required).
DECLINE->SUNSET requires Product Head + CEO approval per CBK product-rationalization governance expectations.
Sunset is RECOMMENDED by criteria; the engine never auto-sunsets a product.
